description: Tauron customer account: payments and invoices.
notes: Login happens on logowanie.tauron.pl with the login and password secrets. After login the home page shows 'Najbliższa płatność' with the amount, 'Po terminie: N dni' when overdue, and each item's 'Termin' date. Invoices are under 'Faktury i płatności' (Faktury); each invoice row has a PDF download. Download only the newest one.

steps.goal: Click the link named Faktury i płatności, then open Faktury.
